title: The Shore Road
subtitle: A location box, anywhere
description: The expedition's map marks the first camp with a box: `position`
one corner, `size` how far the box reaches from it, and -- because
this is an example and does not know your world's coordinates --
`ignoreDimension: true`, so the box counts wherever the road
A pack writing this for real names its dimension and writes the
box its build occupies. The field exists for camps, arenas and
rooms: a task that is a place, drawn to scale.
